summary: A mixed briefing anchored by major Reliance developments and food safety regulatory matters. Key legal judgment on bail, significant Jio IPO approval, and emerging compliance issues in food retail demand attention.

bullets.text: Mumbai Court rejects NIA plea to cancel bail for four Bhima Koregaon accused; proceedings continue.
Reliance Jio Platforms secures SEBI approval for Rs 37,700 crore IPO; Google, Meta retain stakes.
Nestle urges India to consult industry on front-of-pack warning label rules; seeks scientific approach.
Food safety body responds to prominent restaurant hygiene violations; emphasizes remediation over blame.
Vodka captures record market share in India, driven by younger consumers and women demographics.
